heard: The first human craft on Mars carried skis. Its tiny robotic rover was designed to waddle on a tether. Soviet probe Mars 2 arrived in 1971 during a planet-wide dust storm. The lander slammed into the Martian atmosphere at 6 kilometers per second. Blinded by the raging dust, the descent sequence failed completely. The craft smashed into the dirt, destroying the rover on impact. Yet that violent crash made it the first human object on Mars. Nothing made by human hands had ever reached Mars.
